up: For the assay with ChEMBL ID CHEMBL1613930, retrieve all activity records with their standard_type, standard_relation, standard_value, standard_units, and pchembl_value. For each activity, also retrieve the tested compound's ChEMBL ID, preferred name (if available), and canonical SMILES. Ensure that each activity row is included, with the associated compound structure.
sql:
SELECT acts.activity_id,
       acts.standard_type,
       acts.standard_relation,
       acts.standard_value,
       acts.standard_units,
       acts.pchembl_value,
       md.chembl_id AS compound_chembl_id,
       md.pref_name,
       cs.canonical_smiles
FROM activities acts
JOIN assays a ON acts.assay_id = a.assay_id
LEFT JOIN molecule_dictionary md ON acts.molregno = md.molregno
LEFT JOIN compound_structures cs ON acts.molregno = cs.molregno
WHERE a.chembl_id = 'CHEMBL1613930'
ORDER BY acts.activity_id;
